newsitem.title: USA: CoCensys CEO to resign to head spin-off.
newsitem.headline: CoCensys CEO to resign to head spin-off.

text.p: CoCensys Inc Wednesday said Chief Executive Daniel Korpolinski has stepped down to head up a new disease management spin-off venture.

Pending the appointment of a new chief executive officer for CoCensys, the company has formed an Office of the President that will report to the Board of Directors and will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of the company.

The members of the Office of the President are David Lee, Executive Vice President of Research & Development; Eckard Weber, Senior Vice President of Drug Discovery; and Peter Jansen, Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
